title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the color of dusk, she glides in slow figure-eights beneath a lantern of drifting bioluminescent plankton, trailing a ribbon of glitter that hums faintly when she passes the tiny drowned music box she calls home. Every few minutes she pauses mid-waltz, tilts her shell toward the glass, and whispers a stream of silver bubbles, as if telling you a secret you've almost, but not quite, remembered.
